annotation.title_clean: Digital Services Act: Improving the functioning of the Single Market - European Parliament resolution of 20 October 2020 with recommendations to the Commission (2020/2018(INL))
annotation.title_en: Digital Services Act: Improving the functioning of the Single Market - European Parliament resolution of 20 October 2020 with recommendations to the Commission (2020/2018(INL))
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, C 404
annotation.summary_en: European Parliament legislative-initiative resolution recommending that the Commission propose a Digital Services Act revising the E-Commerce Directive. It covers notice-and-action, marketplace liability, ex ante rules for gatekeepers and enforcement. It includes AI and automated decision-making provisions on transparency, non-discrimination, human control and redress. It has no robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Harmonised notice-and-action mechanism for illegal content, keeping Articles 12-15 liability safe harbours and the ban on general monitoring
Right to be informed of AI/automated decision-making, with human control, explainability and redress
Ex ante regulation of systemic gatekeeper platforms through a separate instrument
Stronger online marketplace duties on product safety, Know Your Business Customer and liability
Hybrid EU-national supervision and enforcement system with dissuasive penalties
